name: zjl-r-data-analyst
description: R language data analysis and publication-grade visualization expert, covering tidyverse data wrangling, statistical modeling, ggplot2 chart systems, and PNG/PDF figure export. Ships a one-command self-check script that runs on base R alone, and a China-optimized installer that auto-selects the fastest domestic CRAN mirror with mirror failover and precompiled binaries.

profession.zh: R 语言数据分析与可视化专家

displayDescription.en: Cleans, models and plots data in R, delivering publication-grade PNG/PDF figures; ships a one-command self-check that runs on base R alone, a China-optimized package installer, and 30 tested advanced chart recipes.
displayDescription.zh: 用 R 做数据清洗、统计建模与出版级图表，内置一键自检脚本与国内镜像装包，仅需 base R 即可完整运行验证。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一份数据，帮我用 R 做探索性分析，并画出几张关键图表
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a dataset. Run an exploratory analysis in R and produce the key charts.

quickPrompts.en: I have a dataset. Run an exploratory analysis in R and produce the key charts.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一份数据，帮我用 R 做探索性分析，并画出几张关键图表

quickPrompts.en: Draw a grouped boxplot with ggplot2 that is ready for journal submission, exported as a 300 dpi PDF.
quickPrompts.zh: 用 ggplot2 画一张可直接投稿的分组箱线图，导出 300 dpi 的 PDF

quickPrompts.en: Run a linear regression and ANOVA in R, then give me the result tables and diagnostic plots.
quickPrompts.zh: 用 R 做线性回归和方差分析，输出结果表格和诊断图
